children: Overview
China property management firm's H1 revenue rose 8.1% yr/yr to RMB9.2 bln
Net income attributable to shareholders grew 10.3% yr/yr to RMB2.24 bln
Company declared interim and special interim dividends totaling 100% of core net profit
Outlook
Company highlights industry shift to deep cultivation and quality upgrades in core businesses
China Resources Mixc Lifestyle aims to leverage policy support to drive high-quality development
Company plans to expand shopping mall presence in core and strategic cities in H2 2026
Result Drivers
COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT EXPANSION - Co said revenue growth was driven by expansion in shopping malls and office buildings, including new openings and strategic cooperation projects

PROPERTY MANAGEMENT OPTIMIZATION - Co said property management business growth was supported by structural optimization, efficiency improvements, and expansion in core sectors such as hospitals, schools, and industrial parks
ECOSYSTEM BUSINESS MEMBERSHIP GROWTH - Co said ecosystem business growth was driven by expansion of membership operations and increased points redemption activity

Analyst Coverage
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 18 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the real estate services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for China Resources Mixc Lifestyle Services Limited is HK$50.10, about 23.9% above its August 28 closing price of HK$40.42
The stock recently traded at 17 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 20 three months ago
